instruction: I want to set my Chrome profile name to Christopher. Please change the profile username to Christopher.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome profile name to 'Christopher'. Uses existing get_profile_name getter and exact_match metric. Same complexity as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts profile name from Chrome Preferences file (data['profile']['name'])
Metric uses appropriate exact string match comparison for profile name verification
Expected value 'Christopher' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting profile name to 'Christopher', evaluator verifies profile name equals 'Christopher'
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure profile changes are persisted to disk before verification
State is accessible: getter reads directly from Preferences file on filesystem, independent of UI state
